Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI\-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud\-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats.
   

  

 Recognized as a five\-time Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award\-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of “hot” data for rapid search and investigation, threat content\-as\-a\-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud\-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.
   

  

 Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and to be featured in CRN’s 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100\. Our network of 150\+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.
   

  

 At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes.
* Customer\-Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers.
* Agility in Action: We embrace change and remain unified in our purpose and objectives.


 We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP), and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end\-to\-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in Python, hands\-on experience with Pytest and Playwright, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Python and Pytest.
* Build and maintain modern UI and end\-to\-end automation using Playwright.
* Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Drive an API\-first automation strategy for microservices and platform capabilities.
* Validate REST APIs, service\-to\-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed workflows.
* Validate data\-processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API\-based validation.
* Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test\-data management, and reporting capabilities.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing.
* Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product quality.
* Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes.
* Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices.
* Explore AI\-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.


**Required Technical Skills**
* 5–8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles.
* Strong programming experience in Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Pytest, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Playwright for UI and end\-to\-end automation.
* Strong experience in REST API automation and testing.
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks—not only individual test scripts.
* Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.
* Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.
* Experience testing complex integration and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect\-management tools such as JIRA.
* Strong understanding of software\-testing principles, test\-design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile development practices.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of quality for a feature or product area.
* Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies.
* Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams.
* Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering.


 Why Join Securonix?
   

  

 Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large\-scale data platforms while building quality\-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As a full\-time employee of Securonix, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
   

  

* Health insurance with a total sum insured of INR 7,50,000\.
* Coverage for self, spouse, two children, and dependent parents or parents\-in\-law.
* Personal accident insurance with a total sum insured of INR 10,00,000\.
* Term life insurance coverage equal to five times the employee’s fixed base pay.

title: Performance Engineer -  Performance Testing, JMeter, Load Runner, API Performance & Java/JVM
description:
**Scope**
* We provide 3PL customers with the integrated supply chain solution for planning, TMS, OMS \& WMS.
* The 3PL PSR team works closely with QA, Development, DevOps, DBA, Solution Architect and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications meet performance and scalability requirements.
* The role requires both hands\-on performance engineering and architectural understanding, ensuring scalable and future\-ready implementations.
* The individual will be responsible for designing, planning, and executing performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing for enterprise applications.
* Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers.


**Technical Environment**
* Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
* API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
* Scripting \& Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application \& JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools
* Infrastructure \& Monitoring: Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, OCI/Azure, CPU/Memory/Disk/Network monitoring, Grafana, OEM
* DevOps/Agile: Git, Jenkins
* Cloud: OCI/Azure integrations
* Others: RDP/SSH, Linux command\-line utilities, log analysis, performance profiling, capacity planning, and production performance monitoring.


**What You’ll Do**
* Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios.
* Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers.
* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response\-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root\-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Work closely with Developers, QA, DBAs, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning, scalability assessment, and production\-readiness reviews.
* Identify opportunities to automate performance testing, monitoring, and reporting to improve efficiency and repeatability.
* Participate in release planning and provide performance assessment and recommendations for production deployment.
* Communicate performance findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 1\-3 years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with JMeter and performance test scripting.
* Good understanding of load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.
* Strong experience in API performance testing using REST/HTTP, JSON/XML, and Postman.
* Good understanding of Java/JVM, including heap, threads, GC, and JVM tuning.
* Experience with JProfiler, Eclipse MAT, thread/heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Experience with Linux/Unix, shell scripting, and application/log analysis.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database performance, preferably Oracle, including AWR/ASH and execution plan analysis on OEM.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, InfluxDB, or equivalent monitoring tools.
* Understanding of Kubernetes/containerized environments and exposure to OCI/Azure is preferred.
* Strong performance troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple performance testing activities within timelines.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
**About RedCompass Labs:** 




 RedCompass Labs are payments experts focused exclusively on payments modernization. The company works with banks and platform vendors around the world to deliver scheme migrations, platform builds, and large\-scale modernization programs faster and with less risk than traditional consulting.
 



 Over the last 23 years, RedCompass Labs has delivered 500\+ projects across the world’s major payments schemes and platforms, including SEPA, Swift, the Real\-time Payments Network, and FedNow on the scheme side, ISO 20022 migrations, and FIS Open Payments Framework (OPF), Finastra Global PAYplus (GPP), ACI Connetic, and many others on the platform side.
 



 The company's flagship product is the Payments Expert Agent, an AI solution purpose\-built for the full payments modernization software development lifecycle. From requirements analysis through development, testing, and deployment.
 



 It’s trained on the company's decades of delivery expertise and more than 30,000 curated payments documents. Certified to SOC 2 Type II, the Payments Expert Agent deploys inside the bank's environment and enables modernization teams deliver complex programs faster, at lower cost, and to a higher standard.
 



 In parallel, RedCompass Labs helps banks detect financial crime hidden within payment flows. The RedFlag Accelerator is a global reference for detecting modern slavery, human trafficking, child sexual exploitation, elder abuse, drug trafficking, scams, and authorized push payment fraud. It combines a persona\-oriented detection approach with red flags, crime models, and open\-source intelligence. The Financial Crime Unit delivers practitioner\-grade intelligence and scoring models that support live investigations and law enforcement action.
 



 RedCompass Labs supports clients from offices in London, Warsaw, Brussels, Miami, Boston, Toronto, and Pune. For more information, visit
 
 www.redcompasslabs.com
 
 .
 



  





**Job Title: QA Automation Engineer** 




**Experience Level:** 
 6 to 10 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Pune
 



**Department:** 
 Quality Assurance / Engineering
 



**Reporting To:** 
 QA Lead / Test Manager
 



  





**Role Description** 




  




* We are seeking a QA Automation Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in Selenium, Cucumber (BDD) and Java, underpinned by a solid grasp of object\-oriented design.
* Hands\-on testing experience with one or more enterprise payment platforms (IPF, OPF, GPP or equivalent) is essential. Familiarity with SWIFT ISO 20022 standards and Canadian and US payment schemes, such as Lynx, ACSS/AFT, Fedwire, CHIPS, or equivalent international schemes, is an asset.
* In this role you will design and build automated test frameworks, work alongside cross\-functional delivery teams, and safeguard the quality of mission\-critical payment systems for major financial institutions.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop and maintain robust automation frameworks (TestNG, JUnit or using Selenium WebDriver and Cucumber (BDD).
* Write clean, scalable, maintainable test code in Java, applying sound object\-oriented design.
* Build and maintain automated tests across the full stack — UI, API, middleware and message layers — covering component, integration and end\-to\-end transaction flows.
* Perform functional, regression and integration testing across the payments value chain, covering core processing platforms, middleware and interfaces, operational dashboards and reporting.
* Design and maintain payment test data covering scheme validation rules, exception handling and edge cases.
* Support test environment readiness, including configuration, connectivity and test data refresh, working with client infrastructure teams to keep environments stable through delivery cycles.
* Analyse test results, identify defects, and work with development teams through to resolution.
* Maintain and execute automated test suites as part of CI/CD pipelines.
* Document test strategies, plans and results to meet audit and compliance requirements in a regulated delivery environment.
* Collaborate with developers, business analysts and client\-side QA teams to understand requirements and translate them into test cases, contributing throughout Agile ceremonies including sprint planning and retrospectives.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* **6\+ years** 
 of experience in software testing, with a focus on automation.

title: Senior SDET
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) who views testing as an engineering problem waiting to be solved. In this role, you won't just be executing
   

  

 tests; you will design, build, and maintain the automated testing frameworks, infrastructure, and tooling that allow our engineering teams to ship high\-quality code at speed. You will sit at the intersection of development and QA, operating as a developer whose primary focus is software quality and reliability.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* A minimum of 8 years of work experience is required.
* Automation Framework Architecture: Design, build, and scale robust, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch for web, mobile, and APIs.
* Code Quality \& Testing: Write clean, high\-quality automation code (e.g., using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript) and participate in developer code reviews.
* CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into deployment pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) to achieve true continuous testing.
* Test Strategy \& Execution: Analyse complex business requirements, identify edge cases, and design comprehensive test plans spanning functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Tooling \& Infrastructure: Build internal tools, mock services, and data generation utilities to unblock the development team and accelerate testing cycles.
* Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers and Software Engineers during early design phases to ensure features are inherently testable from day one.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Programming : Strong proficiency in at least one modern language (e.g., Java, Python, C\#, or TypeScript).
* Automation Tools : Deep experience with tools like Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or RestAssured.
* CI/CD \& DevOps : Hands\-on experience with Docker, gitversion control, and pipeline tools like GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
* Database \& API : Proficiency in querying SQL/NoSQL databases and testing RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
* Mindset : Strong debugging skills, a knack for breaking things, and a "shift\-left" testing philosophy.


**Bonus Skills**
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Performance and load testing experience using tools like JMeter or K6\.
* Background in Unit Testing frameworks (TestNG, JUnit, PyTest) and working alongside developers to improve unit test coverage.


**What You’ll Get**
* 18 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self\-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
* Private medical coverage for you and up to four dependents
* Life, accident, and disability insurance with enhanced coverage
* Annual flexible wellbeing allowance for physical and mental wellness
* Free confidential counselling and coaching via Employee Assistance Program (EAP), including legal and financial advice
* Meal, fuel, and transportation benefits based on work arrangement
* Daycare reimbursement and safe cab facility for eligible employees
* Opportunities to learn and grow through on\-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

 and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All your information will be kept confidential.

You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Test Engineer, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Experience in both Manual and Automation Testing.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Design and execute manual and automated test cases.
* Experience in both UI and API functionality and automation testing.
* Hands\-on experience in API and Microservices Testing.
* Hands\-on test automation skills with experience in BDD with Cucumber, Selenium with Java, WebDriver, Karate, Playwright, Cypress.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Ability to identify positive, negative, edge\-case, and comprehensive test coverage scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Proactive and self\-driven mindset.
* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Prior Barclays, Cards, or Payments domain preferred experience.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop, and execute testing strategies to validate functionality, performance, and user experience, while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to identify and resolve defects, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies, to ensure software quality and reliability.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate software functionality and ensure compliance with established quality standards.
* Creation and execution automated test scripts, leveraging testing frameworks and tools to facilitate early detection of defects and quality issues.         .
* Collaboration with cross\-functional teams to analyse requirements, participate in design discussions, and contribute to the development of acceptance criteria, ensuring a thorough understanding of the software being tested.
* Root cause analysis for identified defects, working closely with developers to provide detailed information and support defect resolution.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Automation Engineer L3
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.
 

  
 





 Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human\-in\-the\-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.
 

  
 





 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 







**About the role** 




 We're looking for a
 **Senior Automation Engineer** 
 to own the technical delivery of UiPath automation workstreams end\-to\-end — from design and development through testing and deployment — working with international clients across a distributed, global delivery environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and deploy complex, scalable Intelligent Automation solutions using advanced UiPath capabilities, integrating with various APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.
* Act as a technical guide for junior and mid\-level automation engineers within your pod. Assist the Tech Lead with rigorous peer code reviews to enforce coding standards and reusability.
* **Discover, estimate and deliver Agentic AI solutions implementing the UiPath suite (Studio, IXP, Agent building and Coded agents) effectively**
* **Collaborate with other members of the automation team to deliver solutions that address client needs, including intelligent data extraction use cases leveraging UiPath IXP and custom models.**
* Actively participate in the CI/CD pipeline, writing and executing automated unit and integration tests to ensure flawless deployments and mitigate production risks.
* Take the lead on diagnosing and resolving complex technical defects, optimising performance bottlenecks, and stabilizing processes before handoff to support teams.
* Stay up to date on industry trends and best practices, and continuously improve consulting service offerings



**Must Have Qualifications** 



* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Intelligent Automation software engineering, including practical experience with
 **UiPath IXP (Intelligent Xtraction and Processing)** 
 — converting unstructured and semi\-structured data such as emails, contracts, and invoices into structured data for automation
* Strong proficiency with UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and REFramework
* UiPath Advanced RPA Developer certification
* **Solid experience with AI Center, Action Center and proven expertise in building Agentic AI solutions**
* Exposure to coded agents and agent builder of UiPath
* Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to reverse\-engineer legacy processes and design elegant, efficient modern architectures.
* Strong ability to articulate technical challenges and solutions clearly to both technical peers and project management.



**Nice to have qualifications** 



* Exposure to consulting environments or client\-facing roles
* Python coding skills or willingness to grow technical capabilities
* Interest in upskilling in related technologies such as process mining (e.g., Celonis, UiPath Process Mining), low\-code platforms (e.g., Power Apps), conversational AI (e.g., Cognigy, Druid), or test automation (UiPath Test Suite)
* Experience in Automation Anywhere, Power Automate

title: Functional Test Lead
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Functional Tester – Quality Engineering**
**Location:** 
 Bangalore/Pune
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Functional Test Lead** 
 who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and passionate about quality assurance. This role focuses on validating business functionality across Trade Lifecyle platform and technologies, ensuring that software meets user expectations and business requirements.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business and functional requirements.
* Translate requirements into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.
* Independently lead requirement clarification sessions and identify data dependencies.
* Execute functional, regression, and integration testing across web, API, and backend systems.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects.
* Participate in test strategy and planning for new features and enhancements.
* Identify and report defects, track resolution, and validate fixes.
* Contribute to end\-to\-end testing efforts in Agile environments.
* Support API/UI testing, security testing, and performance validation as needed.
* Provide feedback on usability and user experience from a testing perspective.
* Review product changes throughout the development lifecycle.
* Prepare and maintain test documentation and reports.
* Collaborate with developers and product teams to ensure quality delivery.


**Requirements**
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 10\+ years of SDET experience, with exposure to Fund Accounting or capital markets.
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies (manual and automated).
* Experience with tools like Jira, Azure Boards, Postman, SoapUI, and test management platforms.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, messaging systems (e.g., Solace, MQ, Kafka), and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
* Exposure to automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cucumber) is a plus but not mandatory.
* Experience working in Agile environments with TDD/BDD practices.
* Excellent communication, time management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to identify risks and edge cases in business workflows.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

The role will contribute to keeping the Site Scope (ITS) platform stable by performing hands\-on development work, resolving defects, and supporting platform operations. This role supports Vertiv’s Operational Excellence and Customer Focus strategic priorities by helping ensure the Site Scope platform delivers reliable site requirements capture and assessment capabilities for Vertiv’s global sales and technical teams.
   

  

 As a member of the Digital organization’s Site Scope team, this role contributes to platform development including
 **React** 
 web components,

 mobile features with
 **SQLite** 
 offline support,
 **Node.js**

 **Microsoft SQL Server**

 **AWS AI services**

 **Snowflake**

 **Microsoft Entra**

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
description:
**Job Summary**
 This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross\-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross\-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Product Failure Mode Avoidance \- Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Platform Planning and Architecting \- Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade\-off analysis in collaboration with life\-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
   

  

 Product Software Design and Construction \- Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
   

  

 Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
   

  

**Resposibilities**
* Develop embedded fuel systems controls software per requirements
* Follow all Cummins internal software processes while developing embedded fuel system controls software
* Modify existing software implementation to support the software change
* Verify and document evidence of the software change functioning correctly
* Solve the software related problems by determining the root cause
* Generate a solution to fix the problem identified and verify on test bench
* Highlight software integration changes to peers in a timely manner
* Support global software team to deliver software for global engine programs
* Align with global software development functional excellence practices
* The work will include development in both ‘C’ code as well as in Simulink models.Other tools used for development will include the use of a Cummins proprietary data dictionary and build tool, configuration management tools as well as test tools (oscilloscopes, frequency generators, debuggers, etc.…)


**Skills – Functional/Technical**
* MTech or BTech Electrical Engineering or computer science with embedded controls development focus preferred
* 7 to 9 years industry experience or equivalent academic experience in development of automotive controls software
* Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for model\-based development.
* Experience with programming in C or other imperative and procedural languages.
* Understanding of diesel engines, mechanical systems, especially fuel systems and air handling systems is a plus
* Good communication and presentation skills required for documenting software design, test results and observations
* Experience or familiarity with microprocessor based embedded control system development
* Understanding of AUTOSAR

title: AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI**
* Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18\-agent ZenseAI.QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto\-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure\-Xi, Perf\-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four\-pillar ZenseAI.AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability \& Security).
* Design and refine the archetype\-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight\-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run.
* Keep the platforms LLM\-agnostic and deployable on any client stack — on\-prem, cloud or hybrid — as model\-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm.
* Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25\-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap\-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype.


**Lead Evaluation\-Driven Development**
* Build and govern eval suites — ground\-truth Q\&A sets, LLM\-as\-judge rubrics, frozen baselines — that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact.
* Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue\-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML.
* Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval\-threshold gates, red\-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals.
* Bring evaluation\-driven development practice into client engagements — showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one\-time audit.


**Own Presales and Client Proposals**
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure.
* Architect engagements across the full ladder — AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA — and fast\-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint.
* Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client\-managed, risk\-reward and Zensar\-managed commercial models.


**Present and Articulate Value to Clients**
* Present the ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders — from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers — adapting the narrative to each audience.
* Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session.
* Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board\-ready.


**Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales**
* Present live in client captive sessions and sales pursuits as the senior technical voice for Quality Intelligence, alongside account and sales leadership.
* Run and narrate proof\-of\-concept demonstrations that turn a client's stated risk into a small, credible proof — the practice's proof\-first approach to closing.
* Represent the practice at partner and industry forums as the practice's thought leadership and pipeline develop.


**Build Practice IP and Mentor the Next Generation**
* Contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and industry packs across BFSI, TMT, and Manufacturing \& Retail back into the practice's IP base.
* Mentor and help build out the practice's emerging AI\-specialist roles — Prompt Engineer, LLM\-Eval Engineer, Agent Architect, Trajectory Eval Engineer, Knowledge/RAG Engineer, AI Security Analyst and Adversarial Red/Blue Team Lead.
* Support GenAI and AI\-enablement training for QI associates across the practice.


**Responsibilities**
**Must\-Have**
* Approximately 17–21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands\-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering — automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle — not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background.
* Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi\-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents — unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts.
* Direct experience with evaluation\-driven development: building or governing eval suites, LLM\-as\-judge frameworks, ground\-truth datasets, frozen baselines and red\-teaming / adversarial testing for generative or agentic systems.
* Strong client\-interfacing capability: comfortable owning technical content in an RFP response, presenting to CXO\-level stakeholders, and holding the room in a live client or sales captive setting.
* Ability to talk convincingly across both deterministic QE and probabilistic AI assurance — the “one estate” narrative is the core sell, and the architect has to embody it, not just recite it.
* Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001\.


**Qualifications**
* Approximately 17–21 years of overall technology experience, including a substantial, hands\-on foundation in Quality Engineering / Test Engineering — automation architecture, test strategy and the full software testing lifecycle — not AI experimentation layered on top of a thin QE background.
* Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi\-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents — unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts.

* Strong client\-interfacing capability: comfortable owning technical content in an RFP response, presenting to CXO\-level stakeholders, and holding the room in a live client or sales captive setting.
* Ability to talk convincingly across both deterministic QE and probabilistic AI assurance — the “one estate” narrative is the core sell, and the architect has to embody it, not just recite it.
* Familiarity with the regulatory and standards backdrop shaping AI assurance conversations: EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001\.

**We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 4\+ Years**
**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.

title: IDP Platform Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Integration development:** 
 Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* **Catalogue data:** 
 Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Workflow orchestration:** 
 Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* **Pipeline products:** 
 Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* **Developer enablement:** 
 Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* **Integration runtime:** 
 Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* **Performance testing capability:** 
 Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* **Quality gates:** 
 Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.



  





**Essential** 




  




* **CI/CD depth:** 
 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 Solid working Kubernetes
* **Scripting and APIs:** 
 Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Software engineering:** 
 Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* **API integration:** 
 Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* **Enablement mindset:** 
 A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* **Pipeline security:** 
 Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* **Test automation in CI:** 
 integrate automated testing into pipelines



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* **Durable orchestration:** 
 Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* **IaC:** 
 Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* **Performance testing:** 
 k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* **Ecosystem:** 
 Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* **Security:** 
 Container and Kubernetes security.



  





**Technologies \& Tools** 




  





 The platform environment:
 



  




* **Developer portal:** 
 Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* **Orchestration:** 
 GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* **Delivery toolchain:** 
 GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* **Integrations:** 
 ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
 Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. **IT Equities Technology**
 Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real\-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed \& OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front\-office workflows end\-to\-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real\-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.

* 10\+ years of software development experience, with recent experience in a senior or lead development role.
* Strong proficiency in Java and enterprise application development.
* Experience with, or willingness to additionally code in, C\#.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and relational database design.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery methods.
* Proven experience delivering scalable, maintainable, and reliable software systems.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, architecture, and development best practices.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global stakeholders across multiple time zones.


**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with microservices and event\-driven architectures.
* Background in mentoring junior developers and supporting team capability development.
* Exposure to modern observability, monitoring, and production support practices.


**Education**
* Undergraduate degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. **MES Aveva– Manager, Functional Transformation**
 As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading the design of AVEVA MES solutions aligned to client business and manufacturing requirements.

* Supporting end\-to\-end implementation activities across design, configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare.

* Contributing to proposals, solution development, and MES\-led manufacturing transformation initiatives across process and discrete manufacturing environments.

 Enterprise Performance
   

  

 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.

title: Tools Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a qualified Software Tools Development Engineer to join our GPU SWQA team. The successful candidate will have strong experience applying AI technologies to automate test cases and a deep understanding of Windows operating systems. Extensive knowledge of GPU, CPU, SoC, x86, and ARM architectures is required, along with expertise in PC I/O architecture and common bus interfaces such as PCIe, USB, and SATA. Familiarity with specifications for general PC architecture components is a plus.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Design and implement automated tests incorporating AI technologies for NVIDIA's device driver software and SDKs on windows platforms.
* Build tools/utility/framework in Python, C\# or equivalent which would help automate and optimize the testing workflows in GPU domain. Develop and implement automated and manual tests, analyze results, identify and report defects.
* Rigorously drive test automation initiative. Build innovative ways to automate and expand our software testing.
* Expose defects and constraints; Isolate and debug the issue(s) and find the root cause; Contribute to the solution and drive to closure. Measure code coverage for the software under test, analyze and drive code coverage enhancements.
* Develop applications and tools that accelerate development and test workflows and write fast, effective, maintainable, reliable and well documented code. Generate and test compatibility across a range of products and interfaces and validate different key software applications across a test matrix designed to test both breadth and depth.
* Provide peer code reviews including feedback on performance, scalability and correctness.
* Report test coverage and Go/No\-Go status for deliverables, escalate critical issues, and drive them to closure.
* Participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions to continuously improve deliverable quality, workflows, and processes.
* Effectively estimate and prioritize tasks in order to create a realistic delivery schedule.
* You will have the opportunity to work on challenging technical and process issues and work closely with leadership to report progress, generating effective and actionable reports.
* This is a fully onsite position.


**What We Need To See**
* B.S / B.Tech/M.S in Computer Science / Electronics \& Telecommunication with strong academics or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of programming experience in Python, C\# or equivalent with experience in applying Object\-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Hands\-on experience developing Python scripts using application development concepts like dictionaries, tuples, RegEx, PIP etc.
* Working experience with databases and storage technologies like SQL, MongoDB and Elasticsearch.
* Experience working on Windows OS with a solid understanding of GPU, CPU, and SoC architectures.
* Experience using AI tools to automate test cases as well as end\-to\-end QA workflow.
* Strong communication skills, including effective interpersonal and cross\-team collaboration.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Highly organized, proactive, and quick to learn.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering teams in a fast\-paced environment.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, including the ability to apply sound logic when isolating and regressing issues, along with strong written communication skills.
* Extensive experience with AI\-driven automation.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team environment.
* Development experience fixing regression bugs and implementing or enabling tests for CI/CD pipelines.


 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.  Understanding of AI\-native SDLC practices and how testing must evolve when code is generated or augmented by AI
   

  

 Experience with test architecture at scale — knowing when to test, what to test, and how to maintain fast feedback loops in large codebases
   

  

 Ability to coach engineers on testing practices — shifting quality left and making testing a shared responsibility rather than a bottleneck
   

  

 Comfortable assessing unfamiliar codebases and quickly identifying the highest\-impact quality improvements
   

  

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
 Experience with property\-based testing, mutation testing, or formal verification approaches
   

  

 Background in performance or reliability engineering (load testing, chaos engineering, SRE practices)
   

  

 Familiarity with contract testing in microservice architectures (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract)
   

  

 Experience in financial services quality assurance (regulatory testing requirements, audit trails)
   

  

 Experience defining and tracking quality metrics (defect escape rate, test cycle time, coverage trends)
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Assess the engineering team’s current testing maturity during the discovery phase — identifying gaps in coverage, slow feedback loops, and manual bottlenecks that block rapid delivery
   

  

 Design and implement AI\-native testing strategies: using Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) to generate test cases from requirements, analyse coverage gaps, and detect regression risks
   

  

 Build custom Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) skills and subagents focused on quality engineering — automated test generation, test data management, and intelligent test selection
   

  

 Define quality gates within the AI\-native SDLC that provide fast, automated feedback without creating delivery drag

 Create reusable testing patterns (frameworks, templates, agent configurations) that are made centrally available for use across all engineering teams
   

  

 Work alongside squad developers to ensure AI\-generated code meets quality standards and that testing keeps pace with accelerated delivery

description:

 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient.  Opportunity to lead strategic quality engineering initiatives within a global telecom environment.
   

  

 Exposure to large\-scale transformation programmes and diverse stakeholder ecosystems.
   

  

 Experience in driving innovation, automation, and process excellence in testing practices.
   

  

 Opportunity to influence quality standards and service delivery outcomes at scale.

 Advanced stakeholder and service delivery management in global environments.
   

  

 Strategic quality engineering and risk\-based testing approaches.
   

  

 Resource optimisation and capacity planning at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Implementation of modern QA practices including automation and DevOps integration.

title: Software Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  




**Description**
**ParentPay Group** 
 is the largest EdTech company in Europe with over 1000 employees and more than £130m turnover. The group has a portfolio of software solutions for educational establishments which serve their management, payments, catering and library service needs.
   

 PPG is also the largest provider of school management software in the UK and touches the lives of over one million people every day, streamlining school administration and management to free up time for teaching and learning, with its market\-leading SIMS software solution
   

 SIMS is at the heart of 19,000 schools, including over 700 independent and international schools in 49 countries.
   

  

**What we are doing**
 We are developing a new single authentication solution that will be integrated and used by all products within the ParentPay Group.
   

 A new team will be forming and will be working under a DevSecOps culture using eXtreme Programming techniques, ensuring the highest standards of quality, security and delivery are met.
   

 The product will pass through a formal Service Transition process into live support, but the team should also have a firm focus on live service operations and where they fit into 3rd line support.
   

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Consultant who is passionate about building products that deliver exceptional customer experience. You will contribute towards creating test scenarios, manual Testing, automating the scenarios and benchmarking the performance of products and services in the ParentPay group portfolio.
   

 You will be responsible for understanding the domain as well as technical intricacies of the product working on the product backlog, and aid in delivery acceleration through creative thinking, an evidence\-based approach and a keen focus on user and business value.
   

  

 The product will deliver a new Auth Solution for all group products, so alongside customer facing elements there will need to be a firm technical foundation. A solid understanding of technical principles and an ability to converse and work with solutions and technical requirements is therefore essential to success.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 • Develop understanding of the Domain and technical intricacies of the product.
   

 • Consistently evaluate and become the expert in the domain space.
   

 • Collaborate with the product stakeholders to understand the Acceptance criteria thoroughly.
   

 • Build robust UI/UX solution using .NET, C\#, Microservices, HTML, CSS technologies.
   

 • Would need to work on Azure B2C implementation.
   

 • Strong understanding of architectural principles
   

 • Understanding of oauth api call sequence
   

 • Strong Agile Development Practices
   

 • Ability to work in a technical environment. Should have experience with Whitebox testing techniques.
   

 • Demonstrate clarity of thought and the ability to translate the complex into simple and consistent terms.
   

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
 Essential Skills
 * .NET 8 or later
* Azure ecosystem (ADO)
* C\#
* Strong understanding of architectural principles
* Strong understanding of API Design
* Agile Development Practices


 Desired Skills
 * k8s
* kiuwan or similar for security testing
* JUnit or similar for unit testing

title: SAP CML Test Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: SAP CML Test Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
* As an SAP CML Test Engineer, you will be a crucial member of our cross\-functional team, ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our core Lending applications. You will leverage your expertise in both mortgages business processes and SAP CML to design, execute, and document comprehensive testing strategies. You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Test Strategy and Planning: Deliver a strong contribution with the test team, which will develop, document, and maintain functional and non\-functional test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.
* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re\-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in\-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi\-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.
* Process Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes, methodologies, and tools.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* SAP CML Expertise: Proven, hands\-on experience in testing SAP Consumer and Mortgage Loans (CML) module. Strong understanding of CML configuration, processes, and integration points.
* Testing Proficiency: Minimum of 2\+ years in a dedicated software testing role with a strong grasp of QA methodologies, tools, and processes (STLC, SDLC).
* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi\-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


**Advantageous / Nice to Have**
* Test Management Tools: Familiarity with test management tools, particularly Tricentis Test, for planning and tracking test execution.
* Test Automation Tools: Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks, especially Tricentis Tosca, for creating and maintaining automated test suites.
* Certifications: ISTQB/ISEB or other relevant software testing certifications.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
* Broader SAP Knowledge: Experience with other SAP Banking Services modules (e.g., SAP BP, BCA) or FI/CO is a plus.
* German language skills: would be regarded as a plus point.


**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**
* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.
